# I can sell more detailing services than I have bay hours for. Which do I keep?

> Free tool for auto detailers and mobile detailing shops with limited bay hours: get the exact most profitable set of services to sell after product cost, booking and card fees, consumables and labour. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
